claim: Fleischman said that the reported attack of a Palestinian on Jerusalem Day was fake.
discovery_sources: The Seventh Eye monitoring report; contemporaneous Times of Israel/Jerusalem Post reporting; renewed Hebrew/English exact-phrase and Channel 14 searches
resolution_notes: The Seventh Eye identifies the program as The Patriots and preserves the quoted claim. Contemporaneous reputable reporting independently documents filmed assaults on Palestinians and journalists during the May 18 Jerusalem Day march, but renewed searching still did not recover the exact June Channel 14 episode/date or uniquely match the specific assault/video Fleischman was referring to. Preserve as Unresolved and do not force an adverse verdict from a possibly non-identical incident.
media_status: No exact original Channel 14 segment recovered; no related Jerusalem Day footage is substituted as claim media.
